anomalies.observed: On the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch, top-right 'Programming (SWD)' block), the Tag-Connect header J1 has wires/labels only on its VCC (pin 1), GND (pin 5) and ~RESET (pin 7, tied to the NRST global label). Its SWDIO (pin 2), SWCLK (pin 4) and SWO (pin 3) pins carry no wire and no global-label box. Correspondingly, the MCU U2's SWDIO (pin 46), SWCLK (pin 49) and SWO (pin 35) global-label boxes have no matching label on J1, so those three nets connect to nothing.
anomalies.expected: The SWDIO, SWCLK and SWO lines should be connected between U2 and J1 (as in the reference netlist and as required for a 'standard ARM debug/programming interface' per spec §1), so the header can actually program/debug the MCU.

evidence.quote: J1, a 6-pin Tag-Connect TC2030 pogo-pin SWD/JTAG programming header ... Its pins are VCC, GND, ~RESET, SWCLK, SWDIO, SWO — a standard ARM debug/programming interface (§1)

Root sheet 'Programming (SWD)' block: J1 shows green wires/labels only on GND, VCC and RESET→NRST; SWDIO/SWCLK/SWO pins are unwired, while U2 has dangling SWDIO/SWCLK/SWO global labels (sheet PCB.kicad_sch, page 1)

anomalies.impact: The MCU cannot be programmed or debugged over SWD; the SWDIO/SWCLK/SWO nets are left floating, defeating the purpose of the programming header.

parsed.summary: The passive values, NFC/display/touch bus wiring and power/charge-pump network all match the specification, but the SWD programming header's SWDIO, SWCLK and SWO pins are not connected to the MCU's matching global labels, leaving the debug/programming interface non-functional.
